tools.name: news.headlines
tools.description: Get current headlines, sources, short excerpts, and links from configured public news feeds. Results are saved to Explore in the Web UI.

tools.name: web.search
tools.description: Search the public web for titles, links, and short excerpts. Results are saved to Explore in the Web UI. This tool does not open or read result pages.

tools.name: server.status
tools.description: Read the local server CPU sample, memory and root disk space, and known Docker container states. Snapshot updates once a minute. Running does not guarantee application health. Cannot change server state.

tools.name: weather.current
tools.description: Get current conditions and the next six hourly forecast entries for a named location. If the user gives no location, use the configured default.

tools.name: calendar.events
tools.description: Read events from the configured Google Calendar for a date range. Use start_offset_days 0 for today, 1 for tomorrow, and so on. Use days for the number of calendar days to retrieve.
